The '''First Battalion''' was a unit within the [[Fifth Infantry]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. In [[3643 BBY]] , a squad within the battalion was commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Piloc]] and stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where it was sent to retrieve the plans for a neutron detonator from the ruins of [[Bugtown]]. Unfortunately, Piloc's incompetence led to [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Suzoku]] and half of the squad being killed by the mutated [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] infesting the area. Piloc was unable to convince Privates [[Ganbar]] and [[Erelut]] to go in again, even after he shot Private [[Camm (Sith Empire)|Camm]] for ignoring his order.<ref name="TOR" />
